text.p: First half of 1997 (in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated) Net per shr incl extraordinaries (guilders) 2.13 vs 1.49
Net per shr excl extraordinaries (guilders) 1.68 vs ----
NOTE - Analysts had expected ASM Lithography to report a net profit from ordinary activities of 95-110 million guilders.
First-half profit figures for 1997 include extraordinary income of 31.1 million guilders from the sale of a stake in one of the company's suppliers.
ASM Lithography makes equipment for the production of semiconductors and is 23.9 percent owned by Philips Electronics .
